newsitem.title: UK: Kvaerner says faces $100 mln Japan claim.
newsitem.headline: Kvaerner says faces $100 mln Japan claim.

text.p: Norwegian engineering and shipbuilding group Kvaerner ASA said on Friday it was aware of a $100 million court action in the U.S. courts being brought against it and a joint venture partner by the Bank of Tokyo-Mitsubishi, related to a waste-to-energy contract.

"Discussions are taking place between the various parties concerned with a view to resolving the outstanding issues. Kvaerner considers that the claim is unrealistic and that it is unlikely that the court will be the forum for resolving this commercial dispute," the company said in a statement issued in London.
The company gave no initial details of the identities of the other parties, including its joint venture partner involved in the court case.
It also did not identify in any further detail the contract for constructing a waste-to-energy conversion plant.
